title: After a successful bulk activation the rows leave Inactive without a reload and the mode ends
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. API replay from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location (Copy as fetch from a request of the logged-in session, then edit method, path and body). Setup: make QAPL-CAP-040, QAPL-CAP-041 and QAPL-CAP-042 inactive with PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":[…],"status":"inactive"}, so the Inactive tab holds them plus QAPL-I1…I3. After the test set QAPL-CAP-042 back to active. DevTools Network tab open with Preserve log on.
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory click the Inactive tab and sort by Part Number in descending order.
  2. ⋮ > Activate parts (menu_item_inventory_bulk_status), then click the QAPL-CAP-040 and QAPL-CAP-041 rows.
  3. Click Activate on the bulk bar.
  4. Type the note QA reactivate and click Activate (button_confirm_part_status_change) in the confirmation.
  5. Look at the list, the bulk bar and the Network log.
  6. Open the ⋮ actions menu.
  7. Click the Active tab, search QAPL-CAP-04 and open QAPL-CAP-040's Part History.
custom_expected:
1. The list includes QAPL-I3, QAPL-I2, QAPL-I1, QAPL-CAP-042, QAPL-CAP-041 and QAPL-CAP-040 in descending Part Number order.
  2. The checkbox column shows; both rows are ticked; the bar reads "2 selected" and Activate (button_bulk_activate_parts) is enabled.
  3. The confirmation "Activate parts?" opens with "2 parts selected.", "These parts can be added to new work again.", "Existing records that use them stay as they are.", the "Note (Optional)" field and a blue Activate.
  4. The confirmation closes and toast_bulk_status_updated reads "2 parts updated."; PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status returns 200.
  5. QAPL-CAP-040 and QAPL-CAP-041 have left the Inactive tab without a page reload (no document request in the Network log); the mode has ended: the bulk bar and the checkbox column are gone; the remaining rows keep the descending Part Number sort with no stale rows.
  6. The menu offers Cycle count, Activate parts and Export again.
  7. QAPL-CAP-040 and QAPL-CAP-041 are listed on Active; Part History reads "Activated | Reason: QA reactivate".
